## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
RISK-ON: Low volatility environment (Vol: 16.4%) with full breadth (8/8 sectors positive) — broad-based rally and risk appetite.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy & Chemicals ABOVE TREND: PETKM (1W: +26.84% | 1M: +37.99%) ABOVE TREND, SASA (1W: +15.68% | 1M: +17.17%) ABOVE TREND; Heavy Industry ABOVE TREND: VESTL (1W: +19.29% | 1M: +21.11%) ABOVE TREND, TOASO (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +10.79%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology & Telecom showing divergence with KONTR (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -17.71%) BELOW TREND; Transportation soft with THYAO (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -0.66%) BELOW TREND and PGSUS (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +2.25%) ABOVE TREND but muted.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
PETKM (1W: +26.84% | 1M: +37.99%) ABOVE TREND, HALKB (1W: +22.80% | 1M: +48.87%) ABOVE TREND, VESTL (1W: +19.29% | 1M: +21.11%) ABOVE TREND, SASA (1W: +15.68% | 1M: +17.17%) ABOVE TREND, EKGYO (1W: +13.82% | 1M: +26.15%) ABOVE TREND.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
KONTR (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -17.71%) BELOW TREND, TKFEN (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -5.36%) BELOW TREND, DOHOL (1W: -0.65% | 1M: +1.90%) CORRECTION, YKBNK (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +7.65%) CORRECTION, THYAO (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -0.66%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
High-momentum movers this week: PETKM (1W: +26.84% | 1M: +37.99%) ABOVE TREND, HALKB (1W: +22.80% | 1M: +48.87%) ABOVE TREND, VESTL (1W: +19.29% | 1M: +21.11%) ABOVE TREND, SASA (1W: +15.68% | 1M: +17.17%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Banking broadly strong and leading the market; ISCTR (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, VAKBN (1W: +9.09% | 1M: +20.65%) ABOVE TREND, AKBNK (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +9.21%) ABOVE TREND while YKBNK (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +7.65%) is in CORRECTION — overweight selective bank exposure.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Heavy industry healthy: EREGL (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +5.97%) ABOVE TREND, FROTO (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +12.91%) ABOVE TREND; construction mixed with EKGYO (1W: +13.82% | 1M: +26.15%) ABOVE TREND and TKFEN (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -5.36%) BELOW TREND.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Energy & Chemicals are the clear cyclical leader: PETKM (1W: +26.84% | 1M: +37.99%) ABOVE TREND, TUPRS (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND, SISE (1W: +13.40% | 1M: +8.15%) ABOVE TREND — continue overweight on momentum names but watch mean-reversion risk after large moves.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Risk-on stance: overweight Energy & Chemicals, Heavy Industry and select Banks; trim lagging Tech/Telecom and underperforming Transportation, and take profits on extreme short-term winners while keeping exposure to high-quant names like BIMAS (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
PETKM (1W: +26.84% | 1M: +37.99%) ABOVE TREND, HALKB (1W: +22.80% | 1M: +48.87%) ABOVE TREND, TUPRS (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, KONTR (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -17.71%) BELOW TREND for downside/contrarian setup.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Energy & Chemicals for continuation or pullback after big gains, Banking for earnings/credit flow sensitivity, Heavy Industry for cyclical follow-through.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch XU100 for retention of the short-term breakout (hold immediate support to keep RISK-ON), failure at the prior swing high would signal rotation; macro triggers: USD/TRY moves, Turkish CPI/CBRT commentary, global risk sentiment and oil/commodity moves, plus company-specific earnings/announcements.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON market with low volatility (16.4%) and unanimous sector participation — Energy & Chemicals, Heavy Industry and Banks are driving gains. Maintain pro-cyclical tilt, take profits on sprinting names, and monitor macro triggers (FX, inflation, oil) that could quickly flip sentiment.
